notes.title: Age of Gladiators Reforged - Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11921345/5fa6f42bf2d6a194a640c82681f205d468688f69.png[/img]

It's been a busy Summer.

Along with [i][b]Deadwater Saloon[/b][/i], I would also like to announce [i][b]Age of Gladiators Reforged[/b][/i], a remake of the original 2016 game in the Unity Engine.

The store page can be seen here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2103620/Age_of_Gladiators_Reforged/

As some of you might know, I created the 2016 game in an engine I (barely) cobbled together from several books. It didn't work in most resolutions and UI/quality-of-life changes were near impossible to implement - so I decided to recreate it in Unity from scratch.

The UI has been updated to something made in 2022 (featuring more icons and less text as well as better-looking windows that conform to the overall palette) and many new quality of life additions have been added (daily alert icons across the top for example).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11921345/0e02fdc71435a1a15a26dbc647133c02565cd717.png[/img]

As well, numerous other gameplay and aesthetic changes have been made:

[list]
[*]Combat Mitigation now fed by agility and reflexes as well, making these attributes more useful.
[*]Improved alerts system
[*]Revised Gladiator Expertise system
[*]Revised Player Perks system
[*]Age incline and decline more drastic
[*]Added Killer Instinct and Work Ethic to gladiator personalities
[*]Drastically improved tooltips
[*]Works on most resolutions
[*]Staff, Lender, Other portraits added throughout the UI - now you can put a face to a name
[*]Weapons and Armor now have Stamina costs (making stamina much more important now)
[*]Dodging and Blocking now use Stamina (again, making stamina much more important now)
[*]Greed also affects daily spending of gladiator
[*]Gladiator portraits added to all UI
[*]Stable now contributes to fatigue recovery time
[*]Stable now has countdown for improvements
[*]Custom mouse cursor instead of system one
[*]Added a fight log so players can recap exactly what happened during battle
[*]Scrollbars instead of burdensome next/previous buttons
[*]Animals now have names
[*]More Player Portraits
[*]Fight Setup screens made more efficiently - a fight can now be started with two clicks instead of the many clicks previously
[*]Improved music player
[*]Icons instead of just text
[/list]

These are just some of the changes - there are plenty more I am not thinking of here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11921345/eba73b389169b5fa9d8de8f5c12d04ac684b21dd.png[/img]

Will keep everyone posted. 

[h3]And of course, previous owners of Age of Gladiators will enjoy a discount if they choose to purchase the remastered version.

So please [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2103620/Age_of_Gladiators_Reforged/]wishlist[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2103620/Age_of_Gladiators_Reforged/]follow[/url] Age of Gladiators Reforged today. [/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2103620/Age_of_Gladiators_Reforged/

Thanks!

notes.title: Latest Update & Patch Notes - Additional Game Options - April 19, 2022
notes.content:
Some new game options have been added, making the game either deadlier or more akin to a slow ride to grandma's house.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35600581/1e39e1680cde767d4d94aa39d8950a93e59d6c61.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Added new game option at start: an experience gain speed for your raiders.
[*]Added new game option at start: lower or higher Vigilance for the wasteland based on your actions - this will equate to an easier or harder game overall, depending on the settings you choose.
[*]Added a fourth option to the end game event timing, making it even longer before they begin the enemy begins their invasion.
[*]Added ability for players to minimize side party/unit/location tracker on the right-hand side of the screen - this can improve game performance as this panel tracks all parties, units, and locations in the game every three seconds.
[/list]

This will provide players with more freedom in shaping their gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35600581/39ea8e8a3edcc85599d7038d05dc0dac9600bf19.png[/img]

notes.title: Wasteland Religion - August 13, 2021
notes.content:
Like everything else in the wasteland, the religions there also suck. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35600581/37448f6c26fee1047573c216172d673c1d53af81.png[/img]

[h1]Never go into a major battle without first considering a sacrifice...[/h1]

Your raiders are an unruly and superstitious lot, perhaps offering some water or meat might appease the gods enough to inspire your army to fight a bit better. Sacrifice a bit of beer (sacrilege!) and they might take the offering even more seriously.

However, the option also exists to sacrifice captive workers or even...one of your own raiders, in order to further boost your followers fervor on the battlefield, successfully awakening their blood lust and violent nature. These sacrifices offer significant combat boosts that can make the difference in capturing that settlement you have your eye on. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35600581/ce7755a5cf87feaaa769304ea4f7d9344bfa999f.png[/img]

As well, after battle, you will have a chance to loot either scripture pages which will amplify the duration of bonuses received after a sacrifice, or holy relics which will provide permanent boosts and modifiers to out-of-combat stats. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35600581/1843d7f99ff79bef1fb29baf900eb7f4ccc02862.png[/img]

Hope you enjoy this update!

And remember: in the wasteland, do unto others before they do unto you.

notes.title: Latest Updates & Patch Notes - November 30, 2020
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35600581/cb259ac253f11a5692444c95fce52b9c8771acfa.png[/img]

Numerous updates and changes have been made to the game, lots of them based on the fantastic feedback by the community.

These are the updates of 1.1.7 - 1.2.1:

[list]
[*]Raider leader can now take up to three raiders as spouses (it's the wasteland after all). Each spouse provides a random stat bonus to the leader.
[*]If your party is within a certain distance to your hideout or captured location, the location will detect this and you can now move resources and garrison to it (you no longer have to open the location with your party entering the tile)
[*]Suicide vests cause only half damage to friendlies when triggered and full damage to enemies
[*]Settlements replenish ammunition faster
[*]Radio icon added to units with radios (garrison and formation screens)
[*]Item mods now shown on extraction screen
[*]Base garrison capacity without barracks increased by 5 (now 10 for locations and 15 for bases).
[*]Blood Plumber is now one-time use instead of countdown
[*]Additional description added to party accessories
[*]Enemy raiders in hideout get levels boosted when vigilance levels increase
[*]Shields lost to shield hook are re-equipped again after combat
[*]Adjusted stat comparison of helmets, armor, and shields to reflect potential perk bonuses
[*]Added claymore mine portrait to garrison screen
[*]Attacking and defeating raider party no longer increases vigilance
[*]Operation screens close after quick load
[*]Fixed bug where capturing carpenter would sometimes cause buildings to no longer be built. 
[*]Fixed bug with settlements uprising even with merciful occupiers law in place
[*]Fixed bug where more than one law can be selected when using quick save and quick load on the law screen
[*]Fixed small bug with friendly units not using throw rocks when out of ammo
[*]Fixed bug where Colossus and Headbanger perks were sometimes going away after combat
[*]Fixed bug where player Bruticians were not healing friendlies during auto-combat
[*]Fixed bug where AI was using Blood Plumber multiple times during combat
[/list] 

More to come.

notes.title: Devlog #16 - Combat Classes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35600581/39ea8e8a3edcc85599d7038d05dc0dac9600bf19.png[/img]

In Raiders, there are three classes:
[list]
[*] [b]Masochist[/b]
[*] [b]Hellion[/b]
[*] [b]Brutician[/b]
[/list]
These follow similar playstyles as existing games, with Hellions causing damage in a variety of ways, Masochists being more sturdy, and Bruticians having an array of support abilities.
Each class has four tiers of Perks that can be unlocked after spending points when leveling up. Each Perk is either passive or activated during combat.

Here are the perks for each.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35600581/94b1493d9b9999302ae5f8ec34f84cf08d12f282.png[/img]

[h1][b]Hellion[/b][/h1]
[i]“I enjoy hurting others. Havoc will be wrought and blood shall be spilled when I wade into battle.”[/i]
[list]
[*] [b]Risky Business:[/b] (+5%) Critical %, (-1) Armor Points For Duration Of Combat
[*] [b]Digging Death: [/b](+2) Damage
[*] [b]Dickhead:[/b] (+2) Critical Damage For Every Dead Team Member
[*] [b]Opposites Attract:[/b] (+1) Damage For Each Opponent With Over (40) Hit Points
[/list]	
[list]
[*] [b]Up The Gut:[/b] Standard Attack Allowing Targeting Of Second Row, Bypass Attack Roll
[*] [b]Blood Scent:[/b] (+5) Damage On Bleeding Target
[*] [b]Agile Mover: [/b](+2) Critical Damage If Wearing Light Or Medium Armor
[*] [b]I Spit At Thee:[/b] (+25%) Hit % If Below (5) Hitpoints.
[/list]	
[list]
[*] [b]Hold My Beer:[/b] Deal (+15) Damage During Attack, Reduce Stamina To (0), Bypass Attack Roll
[*] [b]Master Shredder:[/b] (+5) Critical Damage Vs All Light and Medium Armored Targets
[*] [b]Wall Banger:[/b] (+5) Critical Damage Vs All Heavy and Full Armored Targets
[*] [b]Keen To Kill:[/b] (+50) Initiative
[/list]	
[list]
[*] [b]See You In Hell: [/b]Deal (+20) Damage During Attack, Reduce Hitpoint To (10), Bypass Attack Roll
[*] [b]Do Unto Others:[/b] (+10) Hit % If Enemy Has Over (25%) Critical %
[*] [b]Ganker:[/b] (+5) Critical Damage For Each Team Kill
[*] [b]Born To Kill:[/b] (+5) Damage If Initiative Over 120
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35600581/82995ae6fd3949ca9b9a4c79cef6dd9df57538b9.png[/img]

[h1][b]Masochist[/b][/h1]
[i]“I don't mind a bit of pain. You could try and take me down, but you might hurt yourself…”[/i]
[list]
[*] [b]Idiot's Bellow:[/b] (+5) Hitpoints, (-1) Armor For Duration Of Combat
[*] [b]Leather Skin:[/b] (+5) Hitpoints   
[*] [b]Agent Of Shield:[/b] (+5) Hitpoints If Equipped With Shield
[*] [b]Opposites Attract: [/b](+1) Hitpoint For Each Opponent With Over (30) Hit Damage
[/list]	
[list]
[*] [b]Shake It Off:[/b] Removes All Negative Effects
[*] [b]Head Banger: [/b](+10) Hitpoints If Equipped With Helmet
[*] [b]Colossus:[/b] (+10) Hitpoints If Equipped With Armor
[*] [b]Wild Thing: [/b](+1) Armor Points if Bleeding
[/list]	
[list]
[*] [b]Hunker Down:[/b] (+1) Armor Points, (-5%) Hit % For Duration Of Combat
[*] [b]Shanker’s Hours: [/b](-2) Damage For All Melee Attacks Against
[*] [b]Gunning For You:[/b] (-2) Damage For All Ranged Attacks Against
[*] [b]Hit Me Again: [/b](+2) Armor Points if Temporarily Injured
[/list]	
[list]
[*] [b]Strong Back: [/b](+20) Hitpoints, (-5%) Critical % For Duration Of Combat
[*] [b]Stubborn Bastard:[/b] (20%) Chance Of Gaining (+5) Hitpoints After Each Round
[*] [b]Too Stupid To Fall:[/b] No Critical Damage Against
[*] [b]Pack Animal:[/b] Negates Stamina Penalties From Helmets, Armor, And Shields
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35600581/8e859c74e910587c2030a218e9d17ac63f89815e.png[/img]

[h1][b]Brutician[/b][/h1]
[i]“Some consider me a healer -- others an inspirer. Whatever I am, you can't lose with me in your group.”[/i]
[list]
[*] [b]How's The Breath?: [/b]Restores (1) Stamina Of Team Members
[*] [b]Dog Of War: [/b](+2) Stamina
[*] [b]Can’t Touch This:[/b] (5%) Block Chance
[*] [b]The Departed: [/b](+1) Damage To Team For Every Dead Team Member  (Does Not Stack)
[/list]	
[list]
[*] [b]Pass Me The Tape:[/b] Restores (5) Hitpoints Of Team Members
[*] [b]Rock N Roll:[/b] (+2) Stamina To Any Team Member Afflicted With A Disease (Does Not Stack)
[*] [b]Cornered Tiger:[/b] (+2) Stamina To Any Team Member Afflicted With An Injury (Does Not Stack)
[*] [b]What's Wrong?:[/b] (-1) Damage All Opposing Units (Stacks With Up To 5 Other Bruticians)
[/list]	
[list]
[*] [b]Roll The Dice:[/b] (+30%) Critical % For Both Friendly And Enemy Fighters (Does Not Stack)
[*] [b]No Gumption:[/b] (-1) Hit % All Opposing Units (Stacks With Up To 5 Other Bruticians)
[*] [b]Old Sport:[/b] If Hitpoints (5) Or Below, (+3) Damage To Team For Combat Duration (Does Not Stack)
[*] [b]Shit Disturber:[/b] (+2) Damage To Every Team Member (Stacks With Up To 5 Other Bruticians)
[/list]	
[list]
[*] [b]Pass Me The Mop:[/b] Restores (10) Hitpoints Of Team Members
[*] [b]He Was An Asshole:[/b] (+3) Hit % To Team If Dead
[*] [b]Doctor Death:[/b] (+2) Damage With Each Team Heal Or Stamina Recovery Action Used
[*] [b]Grandpa Snuff:[/b] (+15) Hit % For Any Team Member Over 25 Years Of Age
[/list]

As you saw in my earlier post about weapons here, each weapon type (1h Edged, 2h Edged, 1h Blunt, 2h Blunt, 1h Ranged, and 2h Ranged) has a unique set of attacks. Combined with class Perks, there’s a lot of room for customizing and tactical experimentation.

Some of the above may change as launch day comes closer, but this should give you an idea for now of the various abilities available to raiders. 

More to come!

notes.title: Devlog #10 - Hostages, Specialists, and Laborers!
notes.content:
Caravans in the wasteland aren’t always just carrying resources – sometimes their cargo is human. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35600581/20e769a9b2a8b0b6407d338ef9a7727e7115f252.png[/img]

[h1]Specialists[/h1]

Some of those people may be valuable to your organization, folks like carpenters, engineers, armorsmiths, chemists, coopers, scribes, jesters, scavengers, smelters, brewers, and more.
Specialists provide bonuses, unlock buildings for construction in your hideout, and more. 
Once you capture one of these individuals, they will be pressed into service, applying their trade in earnest. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35600581/34c01aa26f7a5f651c07a4e32b398f72fdedf4ba.png[/img]

[h1]Hostages[/h1]

Some caravans will be carrying VIPs instead.

Knocking off one of these caravans will yield a VIP – however, unlike specialists and tradesmen, these so-called “important” people to the settlements of the wasteland are useless to your own organization, so you can take them hostage instead.

The settlements will pay dearly for their release, depending on their importance.
Your options are to either ransom them (for chips), execute them (for fear), or butcher them (for meat). If you’re of the kinder disposition, you can also free them without ransom for a drop in infamy. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35600581/8032d0bfc67555bf90b8edbd15ffc9793c67a788.png[/img]

[h1]Laborers[/h1]

General laborers are also valuable. No settlement will pay for their release and they aren’t as important as specialized tradesmen, but they still serve a purpose. You can obtain workers from raids, from demands, and from slavers.

The more workers you have in your hideout, the faster things are built. Workers can also be assigned to buildings to increase their efficiency. 

So go forth an plunder – resources and money aren’t the only thing you can steal!

notes.title: Devlog #4 – Weapons
notes.content:
[h1]Weapons[/h1]

Combatants in the wasteland equip themselves with whatever they can scavenge, loot, or craft (will discuss crafting, components and reverse-engineering in a separate Devlog). 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35600581/ade5717a470247c2830bf0c117bbc23ebee4b960.png[/img]

Equipment includes the following:

[list]
[*]Weapons
[*]Helmets
[*]Armor
[*]Shields
[*]Special Items
[/list]

With this Devlog, we will address weapons.

[h1][b]Weapon Types - Melee/Ranged[/b][/h1]

Weapons are further classified as both ranged and melee.

Melee weapons come in the following:
[list]
[*]One-handed Edged
[*]Two-handed Edged
[*]One-handed Blunt
[*]Two-handed Blunt
[/list]

Ranged weapons come in the following:
[list]
[*]One-handed Ranged
[*]Two-handed Ranged
[/list]

Each weapon comes with its own set of cool-down attacks and crowd-control abilities. 

One-handed and two-handed weapons also confer stamina penalties on the individual using the weapon.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35600581/c0cbcbf5c71bf102a600b56892690162d27439df.png[/img]

[h1]One-Handed Edged[/h1]

These weapon types are comprised of machetes, cleavers and more.
Actions specific to one-handed edged weapons include:

[list]
[*]Frantic Stab: (-10%) Hit %, (+4) Damage
[*]Slice & Dice: Attack (2) Time, (No Critical Hits, Bypass Attack Roll)
[*]Through The Seams: (-10%) Hit %, Ignores Target Armor Points
[*]Butchers Smile: Apply Bleeding Effect (-5 HP/Turn) For Duration Of Combat (Bypass Attack Roll)
[/list]

[h1]Two-Handed Edged[/h1]

These weapon types are comprised of katanas, trench shovels and more.

Actions specific to two-handed edged weapons include:

[list]
[*]Frantic Chop: (-10%) Hit %, (+6) Damage
[*]Shearing Swing: Hits Up To (3) Targets For (50%) Hit Damage
[*]Guarded Stance: (50%) Chance of Blocking Incoming Attack (1 Turn)
[*]Cleaveland: (-20%) Hit Chance, (100%) Critical Chance
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35600581/e5ee26e655251dd3b89886f472b49664acf610d0.png[/img]

[h1]One-Handed Blunt[/h1]

These weapon types are comprised of pipe wrenches, night sticks and more.
Actions specific to one-handed blunt weapons include:

[list]
[*]Heavy Swing: (-10%) Hit %, (+4) Damage
[*]Full Throttle: Attack (2) Time, (No Critical Hits, Bypass Attack Roll)
[*]Go For The Eyes: Stuns Target For (1) Turn (Bypass Attack Roll)
[*]Bang-Cock: (-1) Stamina On Target For Duration Of Combat
[/list]

[h1]Two-Handed Blunt[/h1]

These weapon types are comprised of hockey sticks, baseball bats and more.

Actions specific to two-handed blunt weapons include:

[list]
[*]Heavy Bash: (-10%) Hit %, (+6) Damage
[*]Swing For The Fences: Hits Up To (3) Targets For (50%) Hit Damage
[*]Grand Slam: (-10%) Hit Chance, (+20) Weapon Damage
[*]Shield Hook: (30%) Chance Of Removing Shield From Target
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35600581/7fea8d70db31710f4af2d112fc7fe6d7e53c39ac.png[/img]

[h1]One-Handed Ranged[/h1]

These weapon types are comprised of pistols.

Actions specific to one-handed ranged weapons include:

[list]
[*]Quick Shot: (-10%) Hit %, (+4) Damage
[*]Hammer Fan: Attack (2) Time, (No Critical Hits, Bypass Attack Roll)
[*]Knee Cap: (-1) Stamina On Target For Duration Of Combat
[*]Ventilate: Apply Bleeding Effect (-5 HP/Turn) For Duration Of Combat (Bypass Attack Roll)
[/list]

[h1][b]Two-Handed Ranged[/b][/h1]

These weapon types are comprised of rifles. 

Actions specific to two-handed ranged weapons include:

[list]
[*] [b]Quick Shot: (-10%) Hit %, (+6) Damage
[*] [b]Death Blossom: Hits Up To (3) Targets For (50%) Hit Damage
[*] [b]Armor Piercing: (-15%) Hit %, Ignores Target Armor Points
[*] [b]Head Shot: (-15%) Hit Chance, (+20) Weapon Damage
[/list]

notes.title: Devlog #2 - Leadership, Succession, Promotions, And Duels (Pre-Alpha)
notes.content:
[h1][b]Leadership[/b][/h1]

In Raiders, you play as the leader of a band of marauders. 

But instead of running your organization from afar, your character must eat, drink, deal with potential insurrections, and engage in combat. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35600581/d9cf7894ecc4c442478446580ff5d0d38cd0187a.png[/img]

[h1][b]Succession Or Permadeath[/b][/h1]

Because your character exists within the world, dying is a possibility. Depending on your game settings, this will either result in your game ending, or one of your raiders taking up the mantle of command instead. 

They will become your new character, meaning you can play for as long as you wish if you have at least one raider still surviving. 

[h1][b]Leadership Points[/b][/h1]

Because the player is a unit like the rest of the raiders under your command, your character will gain experience points from activities in the wasteland and level up. However, your character will also have a second set of exclusive attributes to level up as well that will provide direct benefits to the leading of your organization.

These attributes include the following:

[b]Negotiation:[/b] Lowers the costs of bribing away enemy parties sent to attack you. 
[b]Intimidation:[/b] Increases the amount of fear you gain from raider activities. Fear is used to extort resources from enemy settlements and caravans.
[b]Determination:[/b] Increases the weight capacity of your raider party.
[b]Organization:[/b] Reduces the construction time of hideout buildings and fortifications.
[b]Logistics:[/b] Increases the unit capacity of your party and garrisons. 
[b]Subterfuge:[/b] Reduces the amount of infamy gained from raider activities. Infamy determines the fortification level of settlements, as well as the strength of caravan guards and mercenary parties sent to kill you. 
[b]Mobilization:[/b] Increases the movement speed of your party.
[b]Cruelty:[/b] Decreases the movement penalty of your party from captives.
[b]Charisma:[/b] Increases the morale gained by the activities of raiders in your party. 
[b]Intuitiveness:[/b] Increases the amount of experience both you and your raiders gain from combat and other activities.
[b]Greed:[/b] Increases the amount of loot and chips (currency) gained from combat.  

[h1][b]Promotions[/b][/h1]

You have the choice of promoting two of your followers to the ranks of Lieutenant and Sergeant respectively. Promoting a follower will provide them with combat and discipline bonuses – however, the downside to promoting a raider is that it might empower them to challenge you for the mantle of leadership…

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35600581/3dfbe289592bc8159b67c7a57367065b7f6a9439.png[/img]

[h1][b]Leadership Duels[/b][/h1]

Occasionally, if morale drops within your organization, you will be challenged to a duel. This can only happen however if you promote a raider to either Lieutenant or Sergeant. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35600581/5ab56fc7afad2d7037230a9fd12b22bef8c1fa56.png[/img]

If your character is challenged to a duel, it will be a one-on-one fight to the death with the challenger. If your character perishes, your game will either end or leadership will be passed to the new victor where you will continue playing.


[h1][b]Burden of Command[/b][/h1]

I hope this provides some insight into the extra layer of gameplay I instituted into Raiders. You are not a god-like leader, looking down on your organization from afar...instead you are a character living in the world that must fight, eat, deal with insurrections, plan for successions, and more! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35600581/e76daeaf6315087777c15cb8b98f89e205642703.png[/img]
